subject: Certification integration — roadmap questions & evidence checkpoints
messages:
From: Jordan Price <jordan.price@capellasys.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Certification integration — roadmap questions & evidence checkpoints

Hi Camila / team,

Thanks again for taking the time to talk yesterday. Capella is kicking off a pre-audit intake for a customer who will require both ISO 27001 certification alignment and a FedRAMP IL2 boundary check for their integration with Redwood. Before we schedule the intake call with our auditors, can you confirm a few things so we can scope the evidence request properly?

1) Scope & environments: will our assessment scope include both hosted (Redwood API) and Dedicated (reserved GPU) environments, or is there a recommended min-scope for FedRAMP pre-assessment? Please state which environments you expect to include.
2) ISO 27001 timeline: do you have an internal target date for certification or an internal roadmap milestone to share (e.g., gap analysis complete by X, documentation complete by Y)?
3) Evidence window & sampling: auditors typically ask for a 6–12 month evidence window and sample artifacts (user access logs, change control entries, incident tickets). Are there any retention gaps we should be aware of or a recommended sample window?
4) Control owners: could you provide a short list of control owners (IAM, infra, incident response, change control) and their preferred contact emails?
5) KMS / encryption: do you support customer-managed keys in Private deployments? If yes, can we get a configuration snippet or pointer to the KMS integration docs?

Attached is a short pre-audit checklist from our side — should help orient which artifacts we will request first.

Can you get back to us by next Tuesday (2027-04-26) with answers or a short calendar slot for a 30-minute scoping call? We’d like to share a draft evidence request by 2027-05-03.

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Price
Security Lead, Capella Systems
Attach: Capella_pre-audit_checklist.pdf

From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Price <jordan.price@capellasys.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-19T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Certification integration — roadmap questions & evidence checkpoints

Jordan — thanks for the clear checklist and timeline. Answers below at a high level; Mina and Marissa are looped to fill in the technical and scheduling details. I also added proposed control owners.

1) Scope & environments
- Primary scope: Hosted API (production) and Private deployments (customer VPC) are in-scope. Dedicated reserved pools for a customer can be scoped on a per-contract basis; for your customer we recommend including Dedicated if they plan to use reserved capacity.

2) ISO 27001 timeline
- Internal target: evidence gap analysis complete by 2027-05-15; documentation and policy updates by 2027-06-30; external audit readiness assessment by 2027-08-01. (We can compress timelines for high-priority customers with an expedited intake).

3) Evidence window & sampling
- We retain auth and infra logs for 12 months in the hosted offering by default. Change control (PRs, deployments) and incident tickets are retained for 18 months. For FedRAMP pre-assessment we recommend a 6–12 month window; auditors commonly request samples across environments and a mix of normal + exception cases.

4) Control owners (primary contact)
- IAM / Access: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
- Infra / Deployments: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
- Incident Response: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwoodinference.com>
- Change Control / CI: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>

5) KMS / encryption
- Short answer: Yes for Private deployments (customer-managed keys supported). For Hosted and Dedicated we offer Redwood-managed keys by default; customer-managed keys are available on Dedicated with an enterprise agreement. Attaching a small snippet/diagram of the KMS integration and a pointer to our internal docs.

Proposed next steps:
- Mina to provide a delivery checklist (artifact inventory) and owners by 2027-04-23.
- We’ll schedule a 30-min scoping call the week of 2027-04-26 — suggest Tue/Wed mornings.
- We’ll share the initial evidence bundle outline by 2027-05-03 for your review.

Let us know if the targets above work for Capella.

Best,

—
Camila Reyes
Manager, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
Internal link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2c3D4
Attach: rdw-deploy-diagram-v2.png

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Price <jordan.price@capellasys.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-20T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Certification integration — roadmap questions & evidence checkpoints

Jordan / Camila — quick technical clarifications from infra side:

- FedRAMP level: please confirm whether your auditors are targeting IL2 or IL4. Our Dedicated clusters can be isolated to meet IL2 boundary requirements; IL4 has additional requirements around vetted hardware and high-assurance controls that will require a longer lead time.
- Deployment diagram: the diagram Camila attached is the right starting point. We’ll export an annotated version with hostnames and dataflow labels for the auditor.
- Log exports & sampling: we can produce signed log slices and a hash for each sample window. For SIEM-related artifacts, let us know which collector and timeframe your auditor prefers (CloudWatch/Elastic/BigQuery).
- KMS specifics: for Dedicated with CMKs, we require a 30-day lead to configure key policies and rotation rules with the customer's KMS service.

I’ll prepare the annotated deployment diagram and a short list of example artifacts (PR URLs, deployment IDs, incident IDs) and drop them into the drive folder by Friday (2027-04-23).

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Infrastructure, Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Price <jordan.price@capellasys.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-22T14:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Certification integration — roadmap questions & evidence checkpoints

Thanks — this is helpful. Auditor follow-up: they want to initially target FedRAMP IL2 for the customer's integration. A few follow-ups so we can finalize the draft evidence request: 

- Can you confirm whether you can produce MFA configuration screenshots for the last 90 days and a sample of successful/failed login events for the same window?
- For KMS: please include the example config snippet you mentioned and whether we will see key rotation logs in the exported artifacts.
- Do you have a standard SOC 2 Type II report template or summary that we can use to align control language in the evidence request?

HubSpot: I’ve created a company record for the customer and linked our intake: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/company/98765

We’d like to receive a draft evidence outline by 2027-05-03 and an initial artifact bundle by 2027-05-18 if possible. Are those dates still feasible on your side?

Jordan

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Price <jordan.price@capellasys.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-29T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Certification integration — roadmap questions & evidence checkpoints

Jordan — thanks for confirming IL2 and the HubSpot link. Quick delivery plan from our side: 

- By 2027-05-03: initial evidence outline (list of artifacts, responsible owners, minimum sample windows).
- By 2027-05-12: MFA configuration screenshots, 90-day login event export (anonymized where needed), and change control sample list.
- By 2027-05-18: first artifact bundle (signed log slices, annotated deployment diagram, incident report samples).

Attachments we will include in the first bundle: rdw-deploy-diagram-v2.png, kms-configuration-snippet.txt, sample-login-export-202701-202703.csv (we will obfuscate any PII).

Notes / constraints:
- For Dedicated CMK setups we need the customer's KMS ARN and a 30-day lead to finalize key policies.
- If auditors request >12 months of continuous logs we’ll need to coordinate retention export costs; please flag any hard audit requirements early.

If that schedule works for Capella, Camila and I will schedule the Tue 30-min scoping call next week and share a calendar invite.

—Mina
Mina Haddad
Sr. Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

<thread_summary>Camilla and Redwood infra/security team confirm scope includes Hosted API and Private deployments by default, propose timeline for ISO gap analysis and evidence deliveries. Capella to target FedRAMP IL2. Delivery plan: outline by 2027-05-03, MFA/login artifacts by 2027-05-12, first artifact bundle by 2027-05-18. Attachments referenced: Capella_pre-audit_checklist.pdf, rdw-deploy-diagram-v2.png, kms-configuration-snippet.txt</thread_summary>
